label: Adolescent ID
notes: 82 adolescents, each observed at ages 14, 15 and 16 (3 rows per person).

label: Child of an alcoholic parent
notes: Constant within person (37 of the 82 adolescents are 1).

label: Age minus 14
notes: Time variable centered at age 14 (0 = age 14).

label: Alcohol use score
notes: Higher = more alcohol use. Every value is the square root of a whole number from 0 to 13; how the score was built is not documented in the package sources.

label: Peer alcohol use score
notes: Higher = more alcohol use among peers. Constant within person, so not time-varying; its construction is not documented in the package sources.

label: Peer alcohol use, centered
notes: Equals peer minus 1.018, the sample mean of peer.

label: Child of an alcoholic, centered
values: -0.451 = not a child of an alcoholic (coa = 0); 0.549 = child of an alcoholic (coa = 1)
notes: Equals coa minus 0.451, the sample mean of coa.
